title: Bengal Special Task Force Arrests Woman Linked to Suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed Operative
summary: The Bengal Special Task Force (STF) arrested a Jharkhand woman on charges of being linked to a suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed operative. The arrest was made in connection with an alleged honey-trap network. The STF claimed that the woman, identified as [name], had been in contact with the suspect and was involved in the operation. The opposition alleged that the arrest was part of a larger crackdown on dissent. Police claimed that they had gathered evidence against the woman and were preparing to file charges. The government said that the arrest was made based on credible intelligence and was necessary to prevent further threats.
summary_points: The Bengal Special Task Force arrested a Jharkhand woman on charges of being linked to a suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed operative.
